name: relic-of-the-past
description: Relic of the Past – Electron + React + WASM

scripts.build: rimraf dist release && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --config scripts/build/electron-builder.config.js -c.directories.output=release && rimraf dist release/win-unpacked release/builder-debug.yml release/builder-effective-config.yaml
scripts.build:win: rimraf dist release && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --config scripts/build/electron-builder.config.js -c.directories.output=release && rimraf dist release/win-unpacked release/builder-debug.yml release/builder-effective-config.yaml
scripts.release: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && node -e "const v='v'+require('./package.json').version;const{execSync:r}=require('child_process');r('git add package.json package-lock.json',{stdio:'inherit'});r(`git commit -m \"release: ${v}\"`,{stdio:'inherit'});r(`git tag -f ${v}`,{stdio:'inherit'});r('git push',{stdio:'inherit'});r(`git push origin ${v}`,{stdio:'inherit'});console.log(`\nReleased ${v}`)"
